_comment: Project hooks for Nebula. These merge with the user-level settings in
The distinction that matters: CLAUDE.md and skills are guidance the model
should consider; hooks are behaviour the system guarantees. The v4 chassis
had every motion value it needed sitting in design_v3.py and used '.16s
ease' anyway, because nothing failed when it didn't. This is the nothing
Both hooks end in `exit 0` so a hook failure can never block an edit - the
lint output reaches the model as feedback, not as a wall.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" in *spike/web/*.css|*spike/web/*.js|*design_v3.py) python tools/lint_tokens.py ;; esac; exit 0
